chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Al-Fuḍayl, from Abī Ḥamzah, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, the Exalted:
“Say: I exhort you only to one thing.”
So he said: “I exhort you only to the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام; it is the one thing which Allah, Blessed and Exalted, spoke of:”
“I exhort you only to one thing.”

key_terms.إِنَّمَا: a particle of restriction meaning only or exclusively
key_terms.الْوَاحِدَةُ: the one thing mentioned in the verse
key_terms.بِوَاحِدَةٍ: with one thing; a single central matter
key_terms.بِوِلَايَةِ: with the wilayah; the divinely appointed authority and guardianship
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, identified here as the referent of wilayah
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement or speech of Allah being explained

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of “I exhort you only to one thing” in Shia tafsir?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse “قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَعِظُكُمْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ” by identifying the “one thing” as the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام. In Shia tradition, it highlights that divine guidance and rightful religious authority are central to the Qur’anic exhortation in this verse.
